legend: For his next video, Mr. Beast has gathered n$$$n$$$ contestants on his private planet Island, which, fittingly, is an ocean planet with a single large island. Each contestant is given two numbers ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$, which are the beginning and end of a sequence of consecutive numbers that the contestant has to count, in order. For a prize of 1 trillion dollars, the contestants have to work together to ensure that each contestant counts their own numbers while maintaining a nondecreasing order between all the contestants' numbers.

Now, the contestants need your help to answer q$$$q$$$ queries asking for the numbers that will be counted at various positions. In other words, each query asks for the number at a specific position in the sorted list containing all the sequences merged together.
input: The first line of input contains n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤105$$$1 \le n, q \le 10^5$$$), the number of sequences and the number of queries, respectively.

The next n$$$n$$$ lines each contain two integers ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai≤bi≤109$$$1 \le a_i \le b_i \le 10^9$$$), the beginning and end (inclusive) of the ith$$$i^\text{th}$$$ sequence of consecutive numbers, respectively.

The next line contains q$$$q$$$ integers x1,x2,...,xn$$$x_1, x_2, ..., x_n$$$ (1≤xi≤1014$$$1 \le x_i \le 10^{14}$$$), the position that each query asks about in the sorted list; each position is guaranteed to be valid.
output: The output should be q$$$q$$$ integers, each on a separate line, the number counted at each query's position.
note: The three given sequences are 1,2,3$$$1, 2, 3$$$; 2,3,4$$$2, 3, 4$$$; and 3,4,5$$$3, 4, 5$$$. When merged together and sorted, the result is 1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,5$$$1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5$$$. The queries ask for every index in order, so the whole list is printed.

legend.ai: 在他的下一支视频中，Mr. Beast 在他的私人星球 Island 上召集了 n$$$n$$$ 名参赛者。顾名思义，这是一个拥有一座大型岛屿的海洋行星。每位参赛者都会得到两个数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$，它们分别是一段连续数字序列的起点和终点，参赛者需要依次对这些数字进行计数。为了获得 1 万亿美元的奖金，参赛者必须合作，确保每位参赛者都数出属于自己的数字，同时所有参赛者所数的数字整体保持非递减顺序。
现在，参赛者需要你的帮助来回答 q$$$q$$$ 个查询，这些查询询问不同位置上的数字。换句话说，每个查询都会询问将所有序列合并后得到的有序列表中特定位置上的数字。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$(1≤n,q≤105$$$1 \le n, q \le 10^5$$$)，分别表示序列的数量和查询的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤ai≤bi≤109$$$1 \le a_i \le b_i \le 10^9$$$)，分别表示第 ith$$$i^\text{th}$$$ 个连续整数序列的起点和终点(均包含在内)。
接下来的一行包含 q$$$q$$$ 个整数 x1,x2,...,xn$$$x_1, x_2, ..., x_n$$$(1≤xi≤1014$$$1 \le x_i \le 10^{14}$$$)，表示每个查询在有序列表中询问的位置；保证每个位置均有效。

output.ai: 输出 q$$$q$$$ 个整数，每个整数单独占一行，表示每个查询位置上的数字。
